description.sub_name: 經典戲劇文本欣賞與讀劇表演
description.sub_ename: CLASSIC DRAMA TEXT APPRECIATION AND DRAMA READING PERFORMANCE
description.describe_ch: 這堂課將藉由閱讀與討論經典戲劇文本，以讀劇演出方式，學習聲線及情感，加上表情動作，掌握表現自我的關鍵，增進同學們口語表達的技巧。
description.describe_eh: Students in this class will read and discuss classic drama texts, in the way of reading drama, learning voice and emotion, adding facial expressions, and mastering the key to express themselves and to improve students' speaking skills.

targets.describe_ch: 透過人文藝術經典教育，啟蒙學生跨域學習潛能。
targets.describe_en: Through the classic education of humanities and arts, enlighten students' potential for cross-domain learning

targets.describe_ch: 增進學生清楚表達的能力，建立良好的人際關係。
targets.describe_en: Improve students' ability to articulate and to build good relationships.

readings.tpc_book:
經典劇本:『群鬼』（談宗教）、『小鎮』（談生命）、『訪客』（談死亡）。
1.《群鬼》(Gengangere/1881) 易卜生 (Henrik Johan Ibsen)

gradeRules.evalb_memo:
期中考評量，透過以下兩項目表現為依據：1.個人繳交、提報的[期末演出計劃]作業內容。2.參與兩次集中時間上課之週六工作坊出席記錄。
無考試
期末考採全體學生合作，以[讀劇表演]形式，完成公開呈現。
以出席狀況、學習態度為評量依據。

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
請說明: 期末成果發表 40%+小組工作表現+個人學習心得10%=期末50%
(期中考評量，透過以下兩項目表現為依據：1.個人繳交、提報的[期末演出計劃]作業內容。2.參與兩次集中時間上課之週六工作坊出席記錄。無考試。期末考採全體學生合作，以[讀劇表演]形式，完成公開呈現。無考試。)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1同學參與肢體課程活動,態度須友好，表達善意。例如:勿隨意碰觸他人身體或言語輕忽
2同學之間討論議題,彼此間必須尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經驗、背景和觀點。例如:勿大聲喧嘩,斥責他人言論
3為達成期末呈現的共同目標，要注重團隊合作精神，溝通能力。
*對課堂規則有疑義可及時提出,予以解決後,不可違反。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Students participating in physical activities must be friendly and show goodwill. For example: Do not touch others' bodies or speak carelessly.
2 When discussing topics among classmates, they must respect and appreciate each classmate's personal experience, background and perspective. For example: Don't make loud noises or criticize others' speech.
3. In order to achieve the common goal presented at the end of the term, we must focus on teamwork spirit and communication skills.
* Any doubts about the classroom rules can be raised in time and once resolved, they cannot be violated.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1.建立友善，互惠，共學平台。
2.以團體達成目標為第一要務；個人參與態度很重要。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Establish a friendly, mutually beneficial and co-learning platform.
2. Making group achievement of goals the top priority; individual participation attitude is very important.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
綜合說明
期末呈現，同學執行“經典劇本”閱讀，與相關劇作資料蒐集任務，完成與演出內容需要的“劇情分析”、“角色自傳”等提報和書面作業；另為專題實作演出思考需要，而準備適合服裝、物件。老師彙整學生文字資料，撰寫改編劇本，無剽竊他人作品之虞；演出所需品項，且為學生自行產出，或製作。
成果展內容，皆在合法規範下，進行必要創作或製造事物。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: At the end of the semester, students will read "classic scripts", collect relevant drama materials, and complete submissions and written assignments such as "plot analysis" and "character autobiography" required by the performance content; in addition, they will prepare appropriate costumes and objects for the practical performance of the special topic. The teacher compiles students' written materials and writes an adapted script without the risk of plagiarizing other people's works; the items required for the performance are produced or made by the students themselves. The contents of the exhibition are all necessary creations or productions carried out under legal regulations.
